llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses 'gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps' to read the live GNOME favorites list, which is the authoritative state for the favorites bar.
Metric 'check_gnome_favorite_apps' performs strict length + set equality, so the final list must be exactly ['google-chrome.desktop'] — both vim.desktop and thunderbird.desktop must be absent.
Full instruction coverage: the evaluator inherently verifies removal of BOTH Vim and Thunderbird in a single check.
Parameter handling is correct: expected.type='rule' causes framework to pass config['rules'] as 'rule', and the metric accesses rule['expected'] directly — no wrapping error.
Negative control resistance is strong: the initial state has 3 apps, so a do-nothing agent fails the length check (3 != 1) and scores 0.
No postconfig needed: gsettings is read via command line and does not depend on any open UI dialog.
